summary: Expose bounded data-network discovery through CLI

delivery.outcome: Allow governed runtimes to stream explicit sanitized registries and projections into deterministic data2dsl graphs.
nonGoals: Do not crawl filesystems, networks or repositories.
Do not add authority, execution, planning or LLM behavior.

architecture.decision: Add a fixed CLI adapter that reads exactly one explicit JSON envelope from stdin or a named file and delegates to the existing bounded deterministic discovery core.
architecture.rollback: Remove the discover subcommand and its tests.

commands: python3 -m ruff check src/data2dsl_cli.py tests/test_cli.py tests/test_packaging_metadata.py
validation.evidence: Positive stdin/file graphs, negative duplicate rejection and console-target packaging closure pass.
